title: Vision Quest
description: A teenage wrestler (Matthew Modine) has trouble focusing on his training regimen when a worldly drifter (Linda Fiorentino) takes up temporary residence at his home.

title: Moving
description: A yuppie (Richard Pryor) loses his job in New Jersey and moves his wife (Beverly Todd) and family to Boise, Idaho.

title: Her Alibi
description: A mystery writer (Tom Selleck) provides an alibi and a bedroom for a Romanian beauty (Paulina Porizkova) suspected of murder.

title: Love Affair
description: Engaged to others, a man (Warren Beatty) and a woman (Annette Bening) on a plane plan to meet again three months later atop the Empire State Building.

title: Matchstick Men
description: After meeting his daughter (Alison Lohman) for the first time, a con man (Nicolas Cage) and his partner (Sam Rockwell) try to swindle a boorish businessman.

title: Mama's Boy
description: A 29-year-old slacker (Jon Heder) who still lives with his mother (Diane Keaton) takes action when a self-help guru (Jeff Daniels) threatens his perfect world.

title: Mr. Wonderful
description: If a man (Matt Dillon) finds his ex-wife (Annabella Sciorra) a husband, he can then put her alimony toward his bowling-alley dream.

title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
description: Two overbearing mothers try to help their daughters win a beauty contest for the title of Dairy Queen.

title: Protocol
description: A Washington waitress saves the Emir of Ohtar's life, launching her diplomatic career and a scandal.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: The Dukes of Hazzard: The Beginning
description: Bo (Jonathan Bennett), Luke (Randy Wayne) and Daisy Duke try to prevent Boss Hogg from seizing Uncle Jesse's (Willie Nelson) farm.

title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
description: A Wall Street tycoon's life becomes a shambles when an unscrupulous journalist implicates him in a hit-and-run accident.

title: My Giant
description: A sleazy showbiz agent (Billy Crystal) tries to exploit a very large, gentle man (Gheorghe Muresan) he discovered in a Romanian monastery.

title: A Prairie Home Companion
description: The creator (Garrison Keillor) of a long-running radio show conducts business as usual while his guests, cast and crew (Meryl Streep, Lindsay Lohan, Kevin Kline) prepare for the final broadcast.

title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
description: A CIA operative goes undercover to find a former agent selling nuclear secrets to the Russians.

title: 16 Blocks
description: A boozy, world-weary NYPD cop (Bruce Willis) must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness (Mos Def) who is set to testify against them.

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: Over the Edge
description: A heroin addict sees a body fall past his window and goes outside to investigate.

title: With Honors
description: The sole copy of a 100-page thesis falls into the hands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) who uses it to blackmail a Harvard student (Brendan Fraser).

title: The NeverEnding Story
description: Ducking into a bookstore to avoid bullies, Bastian begins reading a book called "The Neverending Story"; he is transported to the novel's magical kingdom of Fantasia where he must help save the land from an approaching darkness known as the Nothing.

title: The Man With Two Brains
description: A brain surgeon (Steve Martin) finds true love with a mass of cranial nerve tissue he wishes were his wife's (Kathleen Turner).

title: City Hall
description: The New York mayor (Al Pacino) and his idealistic deputy (John Cusack) cope with scandal generated by a policeman's accidental shooting of a black boy.

title: Pennies From Heaven
description: A sheet-music salesman (Steve Martin) escapes his wife, girlfriend (Bernadette Peters) and the Depression through his songs.

title: Strange Brew
description: The Canadian McKenzie brothers (Dave Thomas, Rick Moranis) cork a beer-factory brewmeister (Max von Sydow) who's out to rule the world.

title: Guilty by Suspicion
description: During the 1950s anti-Communist witch-hunts, a film director's career and personal life begin crumbling after he is accused of communist ties and blacklisted.

title: Driving Miss Daisy
description: An Atlanta widow (Jessica Tandy) and her chauffeur (Morgan Freeman) reflect the changing times, from 1948 to 1973.

title: Corrina, Corrina
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) brings joy to a Jewish widower (Ray Liotta) and his young daughter (Tina Majorino) in 1959 Los Angeles.

title: Stroker Ace
description: NASCAR driver Stroker Ace runs into problems when a confrontation with his commercial sponsor causes him to lose his contract. Clyde Torkle, the owner of a fried-chicken chain, immediately asks Stroker to be the face of his company.

title: Frequency
description: Thirty years after the death of his father, a police officer is stunned to find himself communicating with him thanks to an old ham radio.

title: Lost & Found
description: To spend time with an attractive neighbor (Sophie Marceau), a man (David Spade) kidnaps her dog, which proceeds to swallow a valuable ring.

title: The Majestic
description: Residents of a 1950s coastal community mistake an amnesiac screenwriter for a soldier who never returned from the war.

title: Malice
description: Married New Englanders (Nicole Kidman, Bill Pullman) rent the third floor of their home to a suave surgeon (Alec Baldwin) who gets too close.

title: Night Shift
description: A meek man (Henry Winkler), his helper (Michael Keaton) and a hooker (Shelley Long) run a call-girl ring from the city morgue.

title: The Informant!
description: FBI agents receive an unpleasant surprise when they rely on ADM executive Mark Whitacre to gather evidence in their price-fixing case against agribusiness giant Archer Daniels Midland.

title: The Ant Bully
description: Tired of weathering constant attacks on their colony, ants shrink a destructive boy (Zach Tyler Eisen) to their size and sentence him to live among them until he learns the errors of his ways.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: Barcelona
description: Women and Cold War politics surround a U.S. sales rep (Taylor Nichols) and his Navy-officer cousin (Chris Eigeman) in Spain.

title: Hearts in Atlantis
description: A mysterious man (Anthony Hopkins) with a very rare ability enters the lives of a widow (Hope Davis) and her son (Anton Yelchin) in Connecticut.

title: Black Beauty
description: Based on Anna Sewell's novel about a horse in Victorian England and its often cruel treatment by various owners.
